# Educations.com

> > Global platform for discovering and comparing study abroad programs, degrees, and scholarships at universities and colleges worldwide.

Educations.com connects international students with higher education opportunities across Europe, North America, Asia, Oceania, Africa, and South America. The platform features university profiles, program directories, and resources for students seeking undergraduate, graduate, foundation year, and specialized programs like pilot training and aviation degrees.

## Key Topics

- Study Abroad Programs
- International Education
- University Search & Comparison
- Scholarships & Financial Aid
- Degree Programs (Bachelor's, Master's, PhD)
- Foundation Year Programs
- Pilot Training & Aviation Degrees
- Europe (UK, Spain, Italy, Ireland)
- North America
- University Profiles (DCU, Dublin City University, Kingston University)
- Program Finder Tools
- Online Learning
- Liberal Arts Education
- Commercial Pilot Certification
- Flight School Programs

## Getting Started

- [Study Abroad Programs at Top Universities & Colleges](https://www.educations.com/): Homepage for finding study abroad programs at universities worldwide

- [Pilot Training Degree Programs in Europe](https://www.educations.com/pilot-training/europe): Directory of 11 pilot training & aviation programs across Europe
- [Foundation Year Programs in Italy](https://www.educations.com/foundation-year/italy): Directory of 27 foundation year preparatory programs in Italy
